item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar already has a bedtime set for late evening, with a wind-down starting about ninety minutes earlier. That's a good structure. Sleep quality is mostly decided by what you do before bed, not in it. Protect that wind-down window. Dim the lights, keep screens out of reach, and do the relaxation practice you've already scheduled. Your action: set a phone alarm now, labeled "wind-down starts," and stop what you're doing when it goes off.
